name: 公的年金の申告対象を広げる
summary: 現在、公的年金等の扶養親族等申告書は、一定の受給者に提出が義務づけられています。この議案では提出が必要な人を増やし、区民税を申請なしで減免できる場合も設けます。医薬品購入費の控除や住宅ローン控除などの期限、土地の譲渡に関する特例、特定暗号資産の所得への課税方法も変えます。
changes: 公的年金等の扶養親族等申告書を提出する必要がある人を増やす
申請がなくても区長の判断で区民税を減免できるようにする
医薬品購入費の控除の期限をなくし、住宅ローン控除などの期限を延ばす
特定暗号資産に関する所得を他の所得と分けて区民税を課す
who: 公的年金等を受け取り、扶養親族等申告書の提出対象になる人
区民税の減免や税の特例の対象になる人・事業者
特定暗号資産に関する所得がある人
why: 地方税法等の改正に伴い、公的年金等を受け取る人の扶養親族等申告書の提出対象を広げるなどのためと、区は説明しています。

issues.quote: 医薬品購入費の控除の期限をなくし、住宅ローン控除などの期限を延ばす
issues.note: 肉用牛の売却による事業所得に係る区民税の課税の特例を令和12年度まで延長する変更が、changesから抜けています。

issues.quote: 特定暗号資産に関する所得を他の所得と分けて区民税を課す
issues.note: 土地譲渡に係る区民税の特例を令和11年度まで延長し、地すべり防止区域内等の土地を対象から除く変更が、changesから抜けています。

en.name: Expands who must file a public pension declaration
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Suginami City Special Ward Tax Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, certain recipients are required to submit a declaration of dependents and other information for public pensions and similar payments. This bill expands the group of people who must submit one and allows resident tax to be reduced or exempted in some cases without an application. It also changes deadlines for the deduction for medicine purchases and the mortgage tax credit, among other measures, special provisions relating to transfers of land, and how income from specified crypto-assets is taxed.
changes: Expands the group of people required to submit a declaration of dependents and other information for public pensions and similar payments
Allows the mayor to reduce or exempt resident tax at the mayor's discretion, even without an application
Removes the deadline for the deduction for medicine purchases and extends deadlines for the mortgage tax credit and other measures
Taxes income from specified crypto-assets separately from other income for resident tax
who: People receiving public pensions and similar payments who are required to submit a declaration of dependents and other information
People and businesses eligible for resident tax reductions or exemptions, or special tax measures
People with income from specified crypto-assets
en.why: The ward says the changes are being made in response to amendments to the Local Tax Act and other laws, including to expand who must submit the declaration among people receiving public pensions and similar payments.
